details.report: Committed forward repair fece57c. StatsLine ordinary contract failures now use StatsLineValidationError with stable code and metric identity; manifest/total and Judge-continue/Judge-role laws are enforced, while Doctor rethrows unexpected validator failures. Shared lowercase 40/64 Git object-ID validation now covers StatsLine and Doctor contracts; the Git snapshot factory rejects malformed IDs synchronously, discovers repository format, checks width, and verifies the exact object is a commit before tree/blob reads. Added exact typed-error, unexpected propagation, cross-law, SHA-1/SHA-256, malformed/option-like, width mismatch, format mismatch, and blob-object regressions; regenerated dist artifacts. Verification passed: focused suites (17/17), typecheck, isolated-HOME full suite (357 passed, 5 skipped, 0 failed), sequential package/cold-install lifecycle tests, npm pack dry-run artifact check, and diff check. An earlier package run failed because the package materializer only copies Git-indexed files while the new shared module was still untracked; after staging the module, package and full-suite verification passed. No other PR39 classes were repaired.
